+
+Run one phase at a time, inspecting the saved camera frames between motions.
+This script uses only the standard robot service's observations, IK, and actions.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
+
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/runs")
+
+
+def grasp_quaternion(tilt_deg: float = 60.0) -> list[float]:
+    """Local x along world +y; local z points away and down."""
+    a = np.deg2rad(tilt_deg)
+    mat = np.array([[0, np.sin(a), np.cos(a)], [1, 0, 0], [0, np.cos(a), -np.sin(a)]])
+    q = Rotation.from_matrix(mat).as_quat()  # xyzw
+    return q[[3, 0, 1, 2]].tolist()
+
+
+def save_obs(result, name: str) -> None:
+    directory = OUT / name
+    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (directory / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(result.meta, indent=2))
+    for camera, frame in result.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(directory / f"{camera}.png")
+    for camera, depth in result.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(directory / f"{camera}_depth.npy", depth)
+
+
+def observed(robot: Robot, name: str):
+    o = robot.get_obs(depth=True, video="none")
+    save_obs(o, name)
+    print(name, "status", robot.status(), "tcp", np.round(o.group("tcp_pose", now=True), 4))
+    return o
+
+
+def move_left(robot: Robot, name: str, xyz: tuple[float, float, float], opening: float,
+              seconds: float = 2.5, tilt_deg: float = 60.0):
+    before = robot.get_obs(video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(before.meta["proprio"]["now"][:16], dtype=float)
+    seed = np.r_[now[:7], now[8:15]]
+    pose = list(xyz) + grasp_quaternion(tilt_deg)
+    solution = robot.ik({"Gripper_Tip_L": pose}, seed=seed)
+    if not solution["ok"]:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"IK failed for {name}: {solution['error']}")
+    target = now.copy()
+    target[8:15] = solution["q"][7:14]
+    target[15] = opening
+    count = int(round(seconds / 0.1))
+    rows = np.linspace(now, target, count + 1)[1:]
+    rows = np.vstack([rows, target, target, target, target, target])
+    result = robot.submit("joint_position", rows, dt=0.1, video="none", depth=True, note=name)
+    save_obs(result, name)
+    print(name, "status", robot.status(), "tcp", np.round(result.group("tcp_pose", now=True), 4))
+    return result
+
+
+def grip_left(robot: Robot, name: str, opening: float, seconds: float = 1.5):
+    before = robot.get_obs(video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(before.meta["proprio"]["now"][:16], dtype=float)
+    target = now.copy()
+    target[15] = opening
+    count = int(round(seconds / 0.1))
+    rows = np.linspace(now, target, count + 1)[1:]
+    rows = np.vstack([rows, target, target, target, target, target])
+    result = robot.submit("joint_position", rows, dt=0.1, video="none", depth=True, note=name)
+    save_obs(result, name)
+    print(name, "status", robot.status(), "opening", result.group("gripper_opening", now=True))
+    return result
+
+
+def main():

+    parser.add_argument("phase")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
